User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the MPH Booking Central application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user (matches Firebase Auth UID).

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

SessionBooking.title: SessionBooking
SessionBooking.description: Represents a session booking in the MPH Booking Central application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the session booking.

teacherId.description: The UID of the user who created the booking.

teacherName.description: The name of the teacher conducting the session.

programName.description: Name of the program for this session.

details.description: Additional details or notes about the session.

definition.description: Stores basic user information. Any authenticated user can read/write their own document.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

definition.description: Stores session booking information. Any authenticated user can create, read, update, or delete any booking.

params.name: bookingId
params.description: The unique identifier of the session booking.

firestore.reasoning: This Firestore data structure is designed for simplicity, allowing any authenticated user to manage session bookings. The user's role is no longer a factor, streamlining access control. All users are treated as teachers with full permissions on the `sessionBookings` collection. The `teacherId` in a booking links it to the user who created it, but this is for informational purposes rather than for security rules.
